statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate transient symptoms with potential arrhythmic events or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring
The service is medically necessary given the recurrent nature of the syncope and near-syncope
The service directly addresses the documented clinical presentation
The service is essential for evaluating the underlying cause of the patient's symptoms
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
